sourceRule: Root nav role=navigation is named pagination; Content/Item are ul/li. PaginationLink renders Button as anchor with nativeButton=false; isActive sets aria-current=page and outline instead of ghost, size defaults icon. Previous/Next default text and accessible English labels can be overridden for localization. Ellipsis is aria-hidden. The wrapper does not calculate page count, clamp indices, fetch results or implement a disabled prop on PaginationLink. Selected Base UI1.9 Button nativeButton=false supplies role=button and tabindex=0 on the source href anchor. Space activates on keyup; Enter uses native link activation. Modified pointer clicks still carry native href/modifiers. There is no roving arrow selection or automatic page state.
keyboardAndFocus: Real links retain Tab/Enter and normal modified click navigation. There is no roving arrow selection. This reference omits unavailable Previous/Next links at boundaries instead of attaching a fake disabled attribute to an anchor. A router may prevent default onClick and navigate itself; the component does not commit a page index before the caller updates isActive.

protocol: SCXML consumes actual source/native transaction observations; callback objects remain original. Sends document observed callbacks, not second DOM dispatches. Parent-controlled props alone synchronize authoritative values. HTML/CSS is a semantic projection; executable behavior uses actual pinned React wrappers.

link.description: Actual Button-rendered anchor: selected primitive exposes role=button and Space activation.

ellipsis.description: Actual hidden omitted-page glyph, not an action.

previous.description: Actual previous-page anchor distinguished by its source class.

next.description: Actual next-page anchor distinguished by its source class.
